planning_notes: Board is Arduino UNO with authoritative pins A0, A1, A2, D2, D4, D5, D6, D9 preserved as wired in the prose (no rewiring).
A0/A1 are declared as analog inputs for left/right light sensors; A2 is declared as an analog input for battery voltage used by the model to decide charging state.
D9 is declared as a servo_angle output for automatic comparison of light sensors and orientation control (all steering logic is in SysML; this request only provides the actuator command port).
TM1637 is declared on CLK=D4 and DIO=D5 as tm1637_number; display content selection and scaling are handled in SysML.
D6 is declared as a tone_output buzzer for low-charge alarm; duration/pause logic is handled in SysML using elapsed_ms.
D2 is declared as a digital_input for the auto/manual mode button; whether it uses pullup/active-low is not specified, so pull mode/active polarity is left to the catalog default.

Serial requirement in prose says '串口输出 low charge'; since exact fixed-text tokenization is not represented here, SysML must emit the low-charge message via the numeric code gate defined by this serial value.
Control period is chosen as 10 ms as a reasonable scheduling granularity; exact sampling/report cadences belong in the SysML model via elapsed_ms.

configuration_resolution.original_requirement: 构建一个太阳能电池板朝向与充电监测原型系统，使用两个光敏电阻 A0、A1 分别表示左右光照，舵机 D9 调节角度，电压检测 A2、TM1637（CLK=D4，DIO=D5）、蜂鸣器 D6 和按钮 D2。系统自动比较左右光照调整舵机使其朝向更强光一侧，并根据电压值判断充电状态；按钮可切换自动/手动校准模式。若电压长期过低则蜂鸣报警并串口输出 low charge。
